messages:
deploy-bot: Starting deploy window for generation-service: rolling v3.2.1 -> v3.3.0 (runtime pin r2.4). Change window 2026-03-17 22:00-22:30 UTC. Canary: 5% traffic. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/gen/v3.3.0
anna: Heads-up on monitoring strategy — we'll run smoke checks (10m), then ramp if stable. p95 target <= 200ms, error_rate target <= 0.5% for canary. I'll watch the dashboards.
jason: FYI pinned model variant for this rollout: gpt-open-7b-q4 (quantized). Could see small latency variability due to kernel path selection.
sara: I'll own /generate and /embed paths. Alerts set: error_rate > 0.8% OR p95 > 300ms -> auto-pause. Logging hook enabled.
deploy-bot: Canary step 1 complete: 5% traffic shifted to v3.3.0. Observability snapshot: baseline p95=130ms, canary p95=160ms, no errors above threshold yet.
ops-bot: Alert: Spike detected on /generate -> 503-rate 1.6% over last 2m. See dashboard: https://kibana.redwood/services/GEN-12345 (tail errors show upstream timeout).
anna: I'm seeing the same traces. Upstream host /gpu-host-7 returning a bunch of 504s, tail latency ~120s. This looks like backend timeouts, could be kernel/runtime mismatch.
jason: Quick check from perf traces: model load times ok but KV cache miss rate spiked ~3x at rollout start. Kernel selection logs show fallthrough to a new codepath. Might be invalidating cache entries on small seq-length boundary.
sara: Suggest partial rollback for canary only: scale down new runtime pods in canary and route canary back to v3.2.1. Command I'm going to run: ```kubectl -n prod set image deploy/gen-svc gensvc=redwood/gen:3.2.1 && kubectl rollout status deploy/gen-svc```
leila: 👍 agree with partial rollback, reduce blast radius and keep deployment window tidy. I'll coordinate the change.
deploy-bot: Executing rollback for canary subset now. Pausing the rest of the rollout. Notifying on-call and halting post-deploy hooks.
ops-bot: Post-rollback metrics: within ~90s error_rate back down to 0.2%, p95 returned to ~140ms. No further 504 tail spikes observed.
jason: Opening a bug with traces + perf dump and tagging infra-ml. Root cause hypothesis: kernel selection edge causing cache invalidations on some batch sizes. We'll keep v3.3.0 pinned in the dedicated pool until fix.
anna: Updating release notes to mark: "canary paused — investigating KV cache regression; rollback to v3.2.1 for canary." Will reschedule full rollout after fix verification.
sara: Thanks all — we'll keep the change window marked as 'partial rollback' and re-run smoke after fix. Closing monitoring loop for now. :thumbsup:
